name: Data Browser Pressing (Web)
implementation_notes: PressingRecordService/Controller/routes/seeder/factories are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Pressing screens (050/054/058), mirroring ThreshingRecordService's precedent (screen-049) -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence

PressingRecord/PressingDetail/PressingOperationalTarget Eloquent models and their 3 migrations already existed prior to this task -- unchanged by the 2026-08-24 dynamic-row revision (schema itself never needed to change, only PressingRecordService::create()/update()'s row-population logic, mirroring ThreshingRecordService's just-fixed pattern exactly: create() now inserts only the given detail rows instead of forcing exactly 24, update() upserts by id instead of UPDATE-only)

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across the 6 reading columns (mirrors ThreshingRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern exactly, adapted for Pressing's own column names: digester_temp_c, digester_level_percent, press_motor_current_amps, cone_hydraulic_pressure_bar, dilution_water_temp_c, downtime_reason) -- UNCHANGED by this revision, it already correctly counted only filled rows regardless of total row count

PressingRecordServiceTest.php rewritten to mirror ThreshingRecordServiceTest.php's dynamic-row test shape (create() with 1..N rows instead of always-24, update() upsert semantics including delete-on-removal) -- 30 tests total, up from 27

REVISI v3 (tech-spec v3, isolasi Production Line 2026-09-28/29 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): filter `production_line_id` (default '' = Semua Line) di Livewire + query param index()/export() controller API; buildFilteredQuery() memanggil ScopesToActorMill::scopeFiltersToActorMill() lebih dulu lalu memfilter kolom record `production_line_id` langsung (bukan whereHas('station')), sehingga record yang stasiunnya dipindah tetap di line asalnya; line milik mill lain dijepit ke null oleh clampProductionLineIdToMill() tanpa error; pilihan line direset oleh updatedBusinessUnitId(); kolom Production Line (dari relasi productionLine milik record) jadi kolom PERTAMA tabel dan CSV, filter aktif ikut ke ekspor. Diverifikasi 2026-10-03: kode cocok dengan tech-spec v3, `php artisan test` untuk berkas uji layar ini hijau.
